_readme: Registry of the per-person Claude Design projects this repo mirrors. We are on separate Claude accounts with no shared org, so each of us owns a private project holding the SAME design files, and Git is the only thing that joins them. See design/README.md.
_exclude_note: 'exclude' = generated by Claude Design, never mirrored. '.thumbnail' is a server-rendered project preview that changes on every edit and would conflict constantly.
_regenerate_note: 'regenerate' = not mirrored either, but recreated remotely by a dedicated API instead of being copied. support.js is the ~69 KB Design Components runtime; the server hands out an identical, up-to-date copy via create_support_js, so mirroring it would only burn context and go stale.
